races.title: Betfair Exchange Graduation Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KOKTAIL DIVIN was one of the leading novice chasers of last season and could be a cut above his 2 rivals. Be Aware should follow him home assuming his stamina holds over the longest trip he's tackled. KOKTAIL DIVIN (FR) BE AWARE (FR) LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Koktail Divin (1/2), Be Aware (9/4), Leave Of Absence (12/1)

races.title: Bet At Your Best With Betfair Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KYKOROCK readily brushed aside a couple of subsequent winners when making it 4 wins from 5 starts over fences on his return at Worcester, so there's every chance he can defy another rise. Tigers Moon and We're Red And Blue both offered plenty to work on when starting out in this sphere recently and look the main threats. KYKOROCK (FR) TIGERS MOON WE'RE RED AND BLUE
races.bettingForecast: Kykorock (6/4), We're Red And Blue (10/3), Tigers Moon (4/1), Milan Tino (9/2), Bleu D'enfer (12/1), Calgary Tiger (28/1), Sir Tivo (33/1)

races.title: Betfair Supports Safer Gambling Week Newton Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: COSMIC CONNECTION looks well worth another chance to build on his promising novice season. He gets the nod over North Shore and Saint Jeannais , who have both created favourable impressions, while Spanish Darling and Hold The Throw could outrun their forecast odds under speed-favouring conditions. COSMIC CONNECTION (IRE) NORTH SHORE (FR) SAINT JEANNAIS (FR)

races.title: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KOCKTAIL BLEU looks the one to beat following his encouraging fourth in a loaded renewal of the Silver Trophy on return. Give It To Me Oj stands out as the main danger ahead of Smokeringinthedark , who was progressing steadily when runner-up here in the spring. KOCKTAIL BLEU (FR) GIVE IT TO ME OJ SMOKERINGINTHEDARK (IRE)

races.title: Betfair Stayers' Red Rose Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Improving 5-y-o SEANIECON can make light of a 6 lb rise for Cheltenham and continue the O'Neill stable's good recent record in valuable handicap hurdles. Matty's Getaway is another handicapper on the up and he may provide the chief threat ahead of last year's second/third Hartington and Phantomofthepoints . SEANIECON (IRE) MATTY'S GETAWAY (IRE) HARTINGTON (IRE)

races.title: Betfair Chase (Grade 1) (Registered As The Lancashire Chase) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GREY DAWNING can emulate Kauto Star, Cue Card, Bristol de Mai and Royale Pagaille and become the fifth back-to-back winner of this race. Like the selection, Affordale Fury has a good record fresh and last season's Savills winner can give Dan Skelton's charge most to do. Jagwar , who retains the cheekpieces he wore for the first time in the Grand National, looks best of the remainder. GREY DAWNING (IRE) AFFORDALE FURY (IRE) JAGWAR (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Grey Dawning (1/1), Affordale Fury (11/4), Jagwar (7/1), Gorgeous Tom (10/1), Salver (10/1), Handstands (16/1), Konfusion (66/1)

races.title: Betfair Backs Opinions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SALADINS SON finished runner-up in this corresponding event 12 months ago and can go one better in what looks a weaker renewal. Dexperts Opinion has made a bright start for the Bowen yard and looks the danger with the form of his Durham National second having been boosted. SALADINS SON (IRE) DEXPERTS OPINION (IRE) CAUGHTINYOURTRANCE (IRE)
